text:
Orbiton Systems has leased the Brevik ground station in a 12-year deal valued at 48 million euros, the company announced on 14 March 2031.

The lease covers three antenna dishes and the control building. That works out to an average of 4 million euros a year for the full site.

Marit Solvang, Director of Ground Operations at Orbiton Systems, confirmed the agreement. The terms appear in the Brevik Station Lease Agreement (Filing No. BGS-2031-07), published by the station's owning consortium.

The deal was formally signed and announced the same day.

**What it means for the sector:** A 12-year commitment signals that Orbiton prefers fixed, long-term ground capacity over short-term access. For the consortium, it secures a single anchor tenant and predictable revenue. Other operators weighing ground-segment options will now have a clear price benchmark: 48 million euros for a three-dish site with its own control facility.
